The charged AUTOCAST swap, whose Condemn special casts the plain sceptre's built-in spell. The registry has no category for it — the "(a)" suffix is its only mark, and "(a)" exactly: "(au)" is uncharged and cannot fire the special at all.

Without it the engine reports zero damage against tier-2 vampyres for a weapon that works in game.

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Corpbane_weapons — the wiki's canonical list. The corp parameter is PER-ITEM, not "anything named spear or halberd": the Blue moon spear and Hunter's spear are excluded while the Thunder khopesh and King's barrage are included. Poisoned, degraded and (cr) variants of these bases inherit it, which is why these are prefixes. This table builds the registry's corpbane column; the engine then asks that column, so the weaponFlag of the same name is registry-first and answers for known ids without consulting these names.
